Leave granted.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the opinion that the appellant,
Dropati, who is the purchaser, has made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail and, accordingly,
we allow the present appeal.
The appellant, Dropati, in the event of being arrested in connection with the subject case1, shall be released on bail by the trial Court on terms and conditions to be fixed by the trial Court.
In addition, the appellant, Dropati, will comply with the requirements and conditions stipulated under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
The impugned judgment is set aside and the appeal is allowed in the aforesaid terms.

1 First Information Report/Case Crime no. 656/2023 dated 06.11.2023 registered with Police Station  Mauranipur, District  Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh for the offence(s) punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 observations recorded in this order will not be treated as an expression of opinion on the merits of the case.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.

..................J. (SANJIV KHANNA) ..................J. (SANJAY KUMAR) NEW DELHI;
